I've uploaded a video, and its status is "Conversion error". What does this mean?
I've uploaded a video, and its status is "Conversion error". What does this mean?

                                        It means that your video codec was not recognized by our system, therefore please convert the file into another format. Supported file types are wma, wmv, mpg3, mpg, mpeg, avi, mov, flv, mp4, 3gp, asf, m4v, mts, mkv, webm, f4v. Avi and wmv files would be the best choice.
